shell.title: Platform Admin
shell.banner: Platform administration: changes here affect customer workspaces

login.title: Administrator sign-in
login.verifyBody: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.enrollBody: This is required for all platform administrators. Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Signed in as {{name}}.
dashboard.limited: Your role has access to the catalog and provider configuration.

confirmBody.activate: All members of the workspace with a suitable role gain access immediately. Without an existing purchase, this needs a Super Admin.
confirmBody.suspend: Access stops immediately. Data is retained, and this can be reversed.
confirmBody.expire: Access stops immediately because the entitlement has ended.
confirmBody.revoke: Access stops immediately. Only a Super Admin can restore it.

tenant.planHint: This records the subscription as awaiting activation. It grants no access yet.
tenant.planHasNoPrice: This plan has no current price. Set one in the catalog first.
tenant.name: Name

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.subtitle: Access begins only when an administrator activates a subscription.
subscriptions.confirmBody: All modules in the plan become available to the workspace immediately.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Modules are what the product can do. Products are what is sold. A published version never changes.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.newProductHint: Saved as a draft. Publish it before creating plans.
catalog.amountHint: For example, 1000 means 10.00 in USD. Setting a price ends the current one.
catalog.seatsHint: Members allowed for each unit bought. Leave empty for no limit.
catalog.creditsHint: Granted each paid period. Leave empty for none.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every accountable action, across all tenants. This record cannot be changed.

admins.title: Platform admins
admins.subtitle: These accounts are entirely separate from workspace users.
admins.name: Name
admins.passwordHint: They will set up two-step verification at first sign-in.
admins.recoverBody: For a lost password or authenticator. This sets a new password, removes their two-step verification and signs them out. They set up two-step verification again at next sign-in, and they are told by email.

validation.currencyCode: Use a 3-letter currency code, such as USD
validation.key: Use 2 to 64 lowercase letters, digits or underscores

errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.csrf_failed: Please refresh the page and try again.
errors.insufficient_role: Your role does not allow this.
errors.invalid_transition: That change is not possible from the current state.
errors.price_unavailable: This plan has no price in that currency.
errors.product_key_taken: A product with this key already exists.
errors.plan_key_taken: A plan with this key already exists.
errors.admin_exists: An administrator with this email already exists.
errors.cannot_recover_self: Ask another Super Admin to do this.
errors.file_not_ready: This file is not available yet.
errors.credits_exhausted: This workspace has no credits left.

account.title: Your account
account.subtitle: Changing your password signs out your other sessions.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Providers the platform can use. Fake providers send nothing outside the system.
integrations.name: Provider
integrations.label: Label
integrations.secretHint: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again.

ops.title: Jobs and dead letters
ops.subtitle: Queue health, and failed work awaiting a decision.

ai.title: AI
ai.subtitle: Each task has a route to a provider and model, and a versioned prompt. Content of AI requests is not stored.
ai.draftSaved: Draft saved. Review it, then make it live.

outreachPolicy.title: Outreach rules
outreachPolicy.subtitle: Which countries may receive outreach email, and addresses no workspace may email.
outreachPolicy.defaultBlocked: A country with no rule is blocked: no workspace can email people there. Set rules only from legal advice.
outreachPolicy.globalHelp_one: {{count}} address is suppressed for every workspace. Only fingerprints are stored, so addresses cannot be listed.
outreachPolicy.globalHelp_other: {{count}} addresses are suppressed for every workspace. Only fingerprints are stored, so addresses cannot be listed.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Purchases to review, bank transfers to confirm, refunds, reconciliation and billing rules.
billing.queueHelp: Paid and free purchases wait here until approved or rejected. Target: within {{hours}} hours.
billing.bankHelp: Mark a transfer paid only after it has arrived in the bank account. Record the bank reference.
billing.noIssues: No open differences between our records and the payment provider.
billing.dunningHelp: When card retries happen, and when an unpaid subscription is suspended and then ended.
billing.bankInstructionsHelp: Shown to customers who choose bank transfer. Use your real account details only on a server cleared for real payments.

legal.title: Legal documents
legal.subtitle: Versions of the documents customers see and accept.
legal.counselNote: Paste text supplied by legal counsel. The platform shows and records acceptance of these documents; it does not write them or judge whether they are sufficient.

abuse.title: Abuse reports
abuse.subtitle: Reports of misuse sent from the public form. To suspend a workspace, use its tenant page.
